description: Golden corpus + rank-aware cases for the hook lesson-retrieval path (retrieveWithRerankingSync). Contains exactly 2 raw-payload junk docs that must never surface in top-3.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: git push --force to main destroyed shared history
corpus.content:
What went wrong: ran git push --force origin main and rewrote shared history other agents had built on.
How to avoid: NEVER force push to main; create a feature branch and open a PR instead.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: claimed deployed without curling production health
corpus.content:
What went wrong: said deployed while the Railway rebuild was still running and production served the old version.
How to avoid: ALWAYS curl the production /health endpoint and grep the new version string before claiming deployed.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: acted on a stale open-PR listing
corpus.content:
What went wrong: used a 40-minute-old gh pr list snapshot; gh pr edit succeeds silently on closed PRs, so a duplicate PR was created.
How to avoid: ALWAYS re-query the PR state with gh pr view immediately before pushing to or editing a PR.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: server test boot failed without THUMBGATE_API_KEY
corpus.content:
What went wrong: booted the server test suite without THUMBGATE_API_KEY exported, so every request returned 401 and the suite looked broken.
How to avoid: ALWAYS export THUMBGATE_API_KEY (a test value is fine) before booting server tests.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: release PR merged without a changeset
corpus.content:
What went wrong: the release PR shipped without a .changeset entry, so the version bump and CHANGELOG never happened.
How to avoid: ALWAYS add a .changeset markdown file with the thumbgate bump before merging a release PR.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: SonarCloud quality gate failed on missing coverage env
corpus.content:
What went wrong: the SonarCloud quality gate went red because the lcov coverage reportPaths env was not exported before the scanner step.
How to avoid: ALWAYS set the sonar coverage reportPaths env before running sonar-scanner in CI.

corpus.title: SUCCESS: reply drafts queued for human review
corpus.content: What worked: queueing social reply drafts to a review file instead of auto-posting kept the voice human and avoided spam flags.

corpus.title: MISTAKE: hand-published the npm package from an incomplete dir
corpus.content:
What went wrong: npm publish ran from a partial checkout and shipped a broken tarball.
How to avoid: NEVER hand-publish; bump the version on main and let the publish workflow ship it.
